items.text: Superwhisper released S1-mini, a 462MB open-weight model that converts raw speech-recognition transcripts into polished written text.
items.text_zh: Superwhisper 发布 462MB 开放权重模型 S1-mini，可将原始语音识别转录稿整理为流畅书面文本。

items.text: Twin1 AI raised $20 million to develop AI twins that learn individual knowledge workers’ tasks and working patterns.
items.text_zh: Twin1 AI 融资2000万美元，用于开发可学习知识工作者任务与工作模式的个人AI分身。

items.text: Google is adding a chatbot-tuned feed to Discover, reshaping content recommendations around users’ AI conversations.
items.text_zh: Google 正为 Discover 增加面向聊天机器人的信息流，根据用户的AI对话调整内容推荐。

items.text: Amazon Bedrock introduced cross-Region inference for OpenAI GPT-5.6 models, routing requests across supported regions to improve capacity and resilience.
items.text_zh: Amazon Bedrock 为 OpenAI GPT-5.6 模型推出跨区域推理，可在支持的区域间路由请求，提高容量与韧性。

items.text: Pika introduced a music model offering editable tracks and claimed generation costs up to ten times lower than competing music models.
items.text_zh: Pika 推出支持编辑曲目的音乐模型，并称其生成成本最多可比其他音乐模型低十倍。

items.text: Codex and ChatGPT Work added shared read-only threads, letting teams review the process and reasoning behind pull requests through a link.
items.text_zh: Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 新增只读共享线程，团队可通过链接查看拉取请求背后的过程与推理。

items.text: Artificial Analysis added Qwen-Image-3.0 and its Pro variant to its text-to-image and image-editing leaderboards for public comparison.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 将 Qwen-Image-3.0 及 Pro 版加入文生图和图像编辑排行榜，供公众比较。

items.text: AI workload-optimization startup Callosum raised $100 million to help enterprises improve computing utilization for AI systems.
items.text_zh: AI工作负载优化初创公司 Callosum 融资1亿美元，帮助企业提升AI系统的计算资源利用率。

items.text: OpenAI previewed transparent-background generation for GPT-Image-2 API, enabling reusable product, game and design assets with alpha transparency.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 预览 GPT-Image-2 API 的透明背景生成功能，可制作带透明通道的产品、游戏和设计素材。

items.text: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-DSpark draft models, reporting speculative decoding speedups of up to 3.2 times without changing model outputs.
items.text_zh: Liquid AI 发布 LFM2.5-DSpark 草稿模型，称其推测解码最高加速3.2倍，同时不改变模型输出。

items.text: Recraft Studio added Grok Imagine Image 2, MiniMax H3, FLUX 3 Video, Qwen Image 3 Pro and Reve 2.1.
items.text_zh: Recraft Studio 新增 Grok Imagine Image 2、MiniMax H3、FLUX 3 Video、Qwen Image 3 Pro 和 Reve 2.1。

items.text: Meta previewed WildArtifactBench, an internal framework evaluating agents on complex real-world tasks spanning diverse deliverable formats.
items.text_zh: Meta 预览内部评测框架 WildArtifactBench，用多种交付物形式的复杂现实任务评估AI智能体。

items.text: Goodfire opened $1 million in grants and free Silico access for external research spanning interpretability, cybersecurity, CBRN risks and AI safety.
items.text_zh: Goodfire 推出总额100万美元的资助及免费 Silico 使用权，支持可解释性、网络安全、化生放核风险和AI安全研究。

items.text: VS Code introduced Agent Host, enabling persistent agent sessions that can continue across projects, environments, desktop and web interfaces.
items.text_zh: VS Code 推出 Agent Host，使智能体会话可跨项目、运行环境、桌面端和网页端持续运行。
